record.intent_text: Drop database leftovers of the legacy digital content feature [ENG-1375] (#19550) The digital content API was removed in 3.23, but the removal only detached the models from the Django state - the tables and columns were left in the DB so that 3.23 pods kept working during a rolling deploy. 3.24 is the release where they can actually be dropped. Dropped from the DB: - the `product_digitalcontent` and `product_digitalcontenturl` tables - `automatic_fulfillment_digital_products`, `default_digital_max_downloads` and `default_digital_url_valid_days` on `site_sitesettings` Detached from the ORM (the column is dropped in 3.25, as 3.23 pods still select it): - `ProductType.is_digital`, with a `db_default` so inserts that no longer include the column keep working Narrowed the GraphQL enums, as planned by the 3.23 data migrations that deleted the matching rows: - `DIGITAL_LINKS` from `OrderEventsEmailsEnum` - `DIGITAL_LINK_DOWNLOADED` from `CustomerEventsEnum` Also removed the always-empty `digital_lines` key from the fulfillment confirmation notification payload (no email template read it) and the `is_digital` field from the populatedb sample data, which would otherwise fail now that the model field is gone. Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
